recommendation: Keep the source fix. No primary Appointment, AppointmentResponse, Encounter, or terminology source change is needed because those authoritative resources already carry the approved semantics; if the Library model-info examples are regenerated, preserve these R5/R6 Appointment and Encounter shapes.
issue_request: FHIR-22696 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request for R5. It reported that Appointment.participant.required's required ParticipantRequired value set, especially information-only, contradicted the participant definition; the approved resolution added Appointment.subject, changed Appointment.participant.required from a code to a boolean, aligned Appointment/Encounter participant actor references, and expanded AppointmentResponse.actor.
initial_application: The primary Appointment, AppointmentResponse, and Encounter source was applied by #FHIR-22696 commits 21e95de9dc, 99a321f377, d1af9f83a1, and 51c7448ff0. Current StructureDefinitions, examples, introduction text, and Encounter search parameters reflect the approved semantics, but the active Library model-definition examples were not updated.
additional_context: The PA 2020-06-10 minutes confirm the same subject(patient|group), boolean required, Appointment/Encounter alignment decision and 4-0-1 vote. Appointment, AppointmentResponse, Encounter, and Library are active in source/fhir.ini; publish.ini publishes both model-definition content XML files, and the Library examples page links them as CQL-to-ELM model information. Later PA decisions such as FHIR-35841 and FHIR-32347 clarify participant.actor descriptions and optionality without reversing FHIR-22696.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml so Appointment includes subject, Appointment.Participant.required is boolean/System.Boolean with period before actor, Encounter.Participant uses actor instead of individual, and unused ParticipantRequired model type/conversion entries are removed.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: added Appointment.subject, changed Appointment.Participant.required to FHIR.boolean, ordered period before actor, renamed Encounter.Participant.individual to actor, and removed ParticipantRequired type/conversion metadata.

source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml: added Appointment.subject and participant.period, changed participant.required to System.Boolean, renamed Encounter.Participant.individual to actor, and removed QUICK.ParticipantRequired metadata.

related_jiras.note: Earlier PA decision clarified that an Encounter can be about a patient who is not present, matching the case-meeting context reused by FHIR-22696.
Later PA issue added/confirmed Encounter participant optionality guidance; it is already represented on the combined branch and does not alter this fix.
Later PA issue aligned Appointment and Encounter participant.actor descriptions; it is already represented on the combined branch and supports leaving current descriptions as-is.
